page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m4.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results position this instance in the average tier for most compute and memory operations, with a few notable exceptions. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a PassMark CPU score of 34,102.79 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 12,613.0. Memory performance is a relative strength, with a PassMark memory score of 2,753.45, placing it in the top 25% of tested instances. This is supported by a cached read-only memory bandwidth of 1,695.39 GB/sec, though uncached large-block write bandwidth drops to 69.06 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the instance demonstrates strong performance in text generation for small language models, processing 297.4 tokens per second with a 135M parameter model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.u1-c1m4.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or compute-optimized hardware. The absence of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing for flexible configuration. This instance is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, including static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale text processing or small-model LLM inference.
